name: ai-player
subtitle: Fair autonomous AI co-pilot with AI-1, smart production, defense and schematics
author: donatodiaz
description:
Adds a second AI-piloted player (AI-1) and a fair autonomous co-pilot for Mindustry v8.

[accent]Features:[]
- AI-1 is a real Player entity with a name, unit and respawn, controlled by AI.
- Miners, builders and army are spawned with real resource costs (no cheats).
- Dynamic support for Exogenesis and New Horizon content.
- Smart construction roles: economy, defense, power and attack.
- Generated power, defense and powered-turret schematics; your own .msch schematics are supported through role folders.
- Sustainable-resource checks: skips content requiring absent ore or production.
- Optional PC-only local LLM through Ollama with RAG strategy files.
- Natural-language orders: order построй больше турелей, order атакуй врага.
- Compact collapsible HUD, in-game AI command console, self-learning and cleanup.
- Outpost expansion and optional campaign sector auto-launch.

[accent]Commands:[] /ai, /ai status, /ai calc, /ai order <текст>, /ai ask <вопрос>, /ai demolish here, /ai llm on|off, /ai setup.
